blocks.text: A CPA in Tampa Reveals the No. 1 Impediment to Starting a Business

Anyone with a business idea and the passion to pursue it knows that there is one more huge factor to consider before launching the new endeavor: money. It should come as no surprise that the No. 1 impediment to starting a new business is financing. If ideas and passion were enough, the world would be inundated with startups. As it is, only those who can match their passion with a willingness to raise and spend the necessary funds are likely to get off the ground.

Of course, knowing where to find the money and knowing how to get it to flow your way are two different things, but Reliance can help with that, as well. A small business consultant from Reliance can help you prepare grant requests, analyze your financial needs, and help you determine whether you might be able to afford a loan. Once you have secured your financing, Reliance will stick by you when you need tax planning, cash flow analysis, bookkeeping, payroll services, or any other type of small business accounting services.
